# GNU Unifont 16px, Taiwan glyph forms (MOE standard): replacement glyphs.
#
# One glyph per line: code point, character, then 16 rows top to bottom, each 4 hex
# digits for the 16 dot columns (most significant bit = leftmost column). The grid is the
# 16px cell of the source face: row 13 is the last row above the roman baseline.
#
# Each line replaces that character's Unifont glyph in the Taiwan-form (tc) faces of the
# 640x480 target and, or-merged to 12 rows, of the 640x240 target. tools/bake_tc_16px.py
# builds them. Glyphs were redrawn by hand; the characters are the Big5 common hanzi whose
# 12px form in src/wqy-tw-12px.txt differs from WenQuanYi. A character not listed here
# keeps its Unifont glyph.
